scope: Identity references only; no artwork traced from these later explanatory publications.

entries.basis: Visual comparison with the Library of Congress identified19th-century print: paired pedimented porticoes, pilastered corner block, window pattern and raised basement match. Subject identification is inferred from the image comparison; this does not attribute the engraving.

entries.identification: Government Printing Office at a street corner
entries.basis: The official GPO history, PDF107 upper image, identifies the same corner building: roof dormer, flagpole, smokestack and tall rear addition correspond. Its approximate photograph date is not assigned as the date of the specimen cut.
The specimen caption supplies the name. GPO history PDF107 lower image corroborates the arched windows, ornate roofline and corner entrance.
